name: Elecrow
notes: Regular (online) FR-4 service, 1-2-4-6-8 layers, 1 oz or 2 oz outer. Min track/space 6 mil (recommend > 8 mil); 0.25 mm for 2 oz. Premium PCB service (quote by e-mail) offers 3 mil track/space and 0.2 mm holes but publishes nothing else. No inner-layer track rule published.

value_notes.via_drill: Order page: 'Drilling Hole: 0.3mm'. The FAQ PDF says '>=0.25mm for vias; >=0.3mm for through holes' - conflicting; the order page value is used.
value_notes.via_diameter: Not published directly; = drill + 2 x annular ring.
value_notes.via_annular_ring: PDF: 'Annular ring >=0.15mm for 2-layer PCB; >=0.2mm for 4-layer PCB.'
value_notes.hole_to_hole: PDF: 'Spacing between holes >=0.35mm' (edge vs centre not stated).
value_notes.edge_clearance: PDF: 'Minimum distance between PCB outline and trace >=0.7mm (PCB thickness from 0.6mm to 1.6mm); >=1mm (2mm thickness PCB)'.
value_notes.mask_bridge: PDF: 'Width of IC solder mask dam >=0.25mm'.
value_notes.npth_slot_width: PDF: 'Minimum width of slot (rectangle hole/oval hole) Width >=0.8mm; Spacing between slots >=0.8mm' (plating not stated).
value_notes.plated_slot_width: Not stated separately; see npth_slot_width (0.8 mm for slots in general).
value_notes.castellated_hole: 'The minimum diameter of castellated holes is 0.60mm.'
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: Order page: 'Minimum pads Space: 8mil'; PDF says '>=0.15mm'. Order page (larger) used.
